decisionBody.question: Decision:
decisionBody.replyInstruction: Reply to this email with your answer

notifyBody.replyHint: Reply to this email to send feedback to the running session.

tool.requested: Decision requested — pause and end this turn; wait for the reply to be injected
tool.alreadyPending: A decision is already pending — wait for the reply
tool.mainSessionOnly: Call from the main session only
tool.modeOff: Email mode is off — the human is at the screen. Use the question tool to ask in the conversation instead.
tool.notifyModeOff: Email mode is off — the human is at the screen. State the conclusion in the conversation instead of emailing.
tool.modeOn: Email mode is ON — the human has left the screen; request_decision will email them.
tool.modeDisabled: Email mode is OFF — request_decision will use the question tool instead.
tool.notified: Notification emailed — continue working; the human will read it when back
